series_key: developing a trading expert advisor from scratch
mechanism: Custom VWAP resets on calendar-day change (macroGetDate), then accumulates Price += ((H+L+C)/3)*volume and Volume += volume so VWAP_Buff[c0]=Price/Volume; EA binds via ChartIndicatorGet/iCustom + CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,1,Buff) to read the live fair-value level.
data_needed: OHLCV bars with real volume; INDICATOR_SHORTNAME "VWAP"; optional MA params (period, type, shift, color) for parallel buffers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Brazilian futures context (VWAP cited as key for B3 futures); PERIOD_CURRENT chart TF; example dual MAs MME17 and MMA52.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a day-anchored volume-weighted mid as a liquidity/fair-value sensor readable from any custom indicator buffer, not only built-in MAs.
quote: Price += ((high[c0] + low[c0] + close[c0]) / 3) * volume[c0]; Volume += volume[c0]; VWAP_Buff[c0] = Price / Volume;

series_key: developing a trading expert advisor from scratch
mechanism: CopyTicks(COPY_TICKS_ALL) on the full contract (DOL/IND mapped from WDO/WIN minis); drop volume==0 and iflag==0 (BID/ASK-only or direct) ticks; each surviving trade becomes one virtual 1-minute MqlRates bar with high=ask, low=bid, open=last, close=last+(capped volume)*tick_size*buy/sell_sign, then CustomRatesUpdate on a custom symbol for charted tape.
data_needed: Tick stream with flags TICK_FLAG_BUY/SELL, last, bid, ask, volume; synchronized full-contract symbol.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Brazilian mini/full pairs WDO↔DOL, WIN↔IND (e.g. _DOLH22); tape plotted as synthetic 1-minute candles while events are millisecond trades.
why_new_for_mis: Converts raw order-flow ticks into a compact OHLC microstructure encoding (spread as shadow, signed volume as body) suitable as a liquidity/aggressor sensor on the trading chart.
quote: Rates[c1].high = Tick[c0].ask; Rates[c1].low = Tick[c0].bid; Rates[c1].open = Tick[c0].last; Rates[c1].close = Tick[c0].last + ((Tick[c0].volume > 200 ? 200 : Tick[c0].volume) * (Terminal.GetTypeSymbol() == C_Terminal::WDO ? 0.02 : 1.0) * iflag);

series_key: developing a trading expert advisor from scratch
mechanism: Between qualifying trade ticks, lg1 = time_msc - lTime (ms gap) and nSwap counts intervening non-price-changing ticks; format "%02d.%03d ~ %02d <>%04d" (sec.ms ~ nSwap <> volume) with buy/sell color; large lg1/nSwap read as falling turnover before the tape candles alone show it.
data_needed: Millisecond tick times, trade volumes, buy/sell flags; canvas text panel beside Times & Trade.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same full-contract tape as Part 12 (WDO/DOL/WIN/IND); values quoted in milliseconds, not 1-minute bars.
why_new_for_mis: Adds an early liquidity/activity sensor: inter-print latency plus quiet-tick count between aggressor prints, complementary to the visual tape.
quote: checks how much time has passed between trades in milliseconds, and how many trades that did not cause a price change occurred. If these numbers are large, you can understand that the turnover is decreasing.

series_key: developing a trading expert advisor from scratch
mechanism: Four buy/sell candle morphologies from ask/bid/last encoding; when body fails to touch the bid–ask shadow, interpret as stop-order fills that jump price inside the spread; runs of such candles flag stop cascades that can reverse quickly versus genuine flow.
data_needed: Per-trade ask, bid, last from Times & Trade candle construction; visual inspection of body vs shadow contact.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Full-contract Brazilian futures tape; millisecond events rendered as virtual minute candles.
why_new_for_mis: Regime-change cue from microstructure geometry: body–shadow discontinuity as a stop-run / cascade detector rather than trend strength.
quote: a big series of candlesticks not touching the shadow represents triggered stop orders.... Without this, you do not see the triggering of stops and may think that the movement has gained strength while actually it can get back quickly

series_key: developing a trading expert advisor from scratch
mechanism: def_MaxTrailMinutes=30; on each buy/sell tick, Momentum = minute_of_tick mod 30; when minute bucket rolls, zero that slice then m_TrailG30[Momentum].nVolume[price_pos] += volume; Redraw overlays royal-blue bar = sum of 30 one-minute slices vs full-session VaP, so recent vs stale accumulation at each price is visible without changing chart TF.
data_needed: Tick last, volume, BUY/SELL flags; price grid from FirstPrice and point-per-tick; 30-bucket trail matrix.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Futures (WDO example 0.5 ticks); trail is 1-minute buckets up to 30 minutes independent of chart TF (5/10/30/60 min charts discussed).
why_new_for_mis: Time-decayed volume-at-price trail senses whether a level’s liquidity is fresh (post stop-flush return) or leftover session mass—finer than static VaP.
quote: when tracking switches to 31st minute, the first trading minute will no longer be displayed.... Together with the Times & Trade they form a double noise analysis tool

series_key: developing a trading robot in python
mechanism: probability_of_winning = abs(signal[-1]-0.5)*2; optimal_volume from Kelly using that probability and risk_reward_ratio, further cut when daily_drop>0.02. Uses model confidence margin as a live edge intensity sensor for sizing.
data_needed: Latest model.predict score in [0,1]; account balance; risk_reward_ratio; bid/ask.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same FX basket as online_trading loop; fixed SL 150 pts / TP 800 pts in examples.
why_new_for_mis: Turns classifier distance-from-0.5 into a continuous confidence/edge sensor driving Kelly size—sensing of signal strength, not just binary direction.
quote: We will use the distance between the model's prediction and 0.5 as the winning probability. The closer the model's prediction is to 0.5, the lower the probability of winning

mechanism: CandleType maps each bar to {A,G,H,E,a,g,h,e,D,_} via body vs wick ratios (e.g. body>1.5*wicks→Marubozu A/a; 2*body<both wicks→spin G/g; lowerWick>2.5*body & >2*upper→pin H/h; close==open→D; else _); CountFromSeries yields counts/% over a lookback window as a structural regime profile.
data_needed: OHLC history; lookback N (demo 1500); Part-1 wick/body thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD and XAUUSD on H1, M15, M5 (1500 bars each); demos also GBPJPY H1/M15/M5.
why_new_for_mis: Replaces visual candle lore with a measurable morphology histogram (dominant A/a ≈40%, _ ≈32–37%, bull/bear symmetry) as a portable regime fingerprint across assets/TFs.
quote: The Marubozu category (A/a) is the most frequent across instruments and timeframes. SpinTop (G/g) tends to be the second most common.... Bullish vs. bearish totals are closely matched in all samples

mechanism: Track percentage of '_' (fails all classification rules) and 'D' across TFs; high _ (32–37%) flags taxonomy gap/noise; GBPUSD M5 D rises to 3.07% vs ~0.5% on H1, read as short-horizon indecision/equilibrium.
data_needed: Same encoded series counts for D and _.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD vs XAUUSD H1/M15/M5 comparative table.
why_new_for_mis: Unclassified mass and doji rate are explicit regime/noise sensors: how much price action is outside named morphologies and how often bars are pure indecision.
quote: A substantial fraction (≈32–37%) of candles are unclassified (“_”).... Lower timeframes (M5) show an increased incidence of neutral/doji candles in some samples, which is consistent with higher short-term indecision and noise.

mechanism: Sliding window of plen=2 over the encoded string yields 1499 ordered digrams from 1500 bars; CountPatterns + SortPatternsByCount ranks transitions; Aa ≠ aA. After filtering patterns containing '_', dominant fully-classified digrams are Aa/aA/aa/AA (~3–5.6%), sensing continuation vs flip of strong-body regimes.
data_needed: Encoded single-candle series from Part 3; pattern length plen; optional filter excluding '_'.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD & XAUUSD H1/M15/M5; demos GBPJPY H1 (2500, plen=2), EURAUD H4 (5000, plen=3), US30/US500Cash M30 (7000, plen=4), BrentCash H1 (10000, plen=5).
why_new_for_mis: Sequence-level transition frequencies give MIS a change/regime-path sensor: which morphology follows which, ranked by empirical rate—not just static candle mix.
quote: Aa is treated differently from aA, even though both contain the same two candle categories. This distinction is important because the order of candles carries information about the direction and transition of price action.

mechanism: Across both FX and gold, top raw digrams are always '__' (≈11–14%) then '_A'/'_a'/'A_'/'a_'; high consecutive-unclassified clustering measures how often the encoding loses structure and motivates bullish/bearish subdivision of '_'.
data_needed: Ranked digram tables including underscore patterns.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD and XAUUSD H1/M15/M5; same hierarchy in multi-asset demos.
why_new_for_mis: Treats runs of unclassified symbols as a meta-sensor of encoding coverage / illegible microstructure, useful before trusting classified transition stats.
